## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the refresh before merge because adding a new file can make verification accept a hand-edited tracked file.

## Changes

The pull request adds two helpers that update the fingerprint manifest and tests for adding files and preserving existing fingerprints.

## Critical

- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve tracked fingerprints when adding files — Refreshing with an edited `tracked.txt` and a new `new.txt` replaces the stored digest for `tracked.txt`. The assignment updates every supplied name. — After the refresh, verification accepts the hand-edited file as valid. — Fix: Delegate to `register_new_files` and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries`.

## Important

- app/integrity.py:25 — correctness — Exclude the manifest from its own entries — When a root-level scan includes the previously unlisted `fingerprints.json`, registration stores a digest of the manifest and then rewrites it. Refresh has the same behavior at `app/integrity.py:17`. — Verification fails immediately after either update because the manifest’s stored digest describes its previous contents.
